blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court on Day 39 accepted the prosecution’s withdrawal of articles on confidential funds, bribery, and grave threats, leaving only the unexplained wealth charge against Vice President Sara Duterte. Presiding Officer Francis Escudero announced: The court accepts and confirms the prosecution’s manifestation… Articles I, III and IV from this point forward are hereby withdrawn.
